articles.title: Wachsende Ungleichheit: So schadet der Börsenboom der Demokratie
articles.teaser: Von hohen Aktienkursen profitieren Reiche besonders stark. Ärmere hingegen werden durch steigende Preise und Mieten zunehmend abgehängt. Das ist politisch gefährlich.
articles.image_title: Wachsende Ungleichheit: Protestor with "Tax The Rich" written on her back during a demonstration marking International Workers Day, organized by major labor unions (CGT, CFDT, SNES FSU, Solidaires, etc.) in Toulouse, in southwestern France, on May 1, 2026. A few days earlier, the government's bill to allow certain occupational groups to work on that day had been withdrawn, a move that, for the unions and left-wing parties, would have called into question the very principle of this day off. (Photo by Pat Batard / Hans Lucas / AFP via Getty Images)
